subject: SCI AND TECH
bill.title: Requires artificial intelligence companion operators to provide notifications that users are not communicating with human.

action.description: Reported and Referred to Assembly Appropriations Committee

posted_text:
🧠 NJ A4732 — AI Companions Must Warn You It's Not Human

New Jersey is considering a rule that would require operators of artificial intelligence companion models – systems designed to mimic human relationships – to clearly notify users that they aren’t talking to a real person. The AI must provide this warning at the start of each interaction and repeat it every three hours. Companies violating this rule could face a $15,000 penalty. ...
